What a session is told: the global instructions and profile fragments, the skills with
no other home, and the assembly of traceable context from owner fragments with a
provenance manifest.

## Install

Run `just setup` after a clone to prepare worktree storage, initialize the pinned
submodules (`vendor/superpowers`, `vendor/agent-skills`) and install the locked test
environment (pytest and pytest-xdist, from `uv.lock`) into `.venv`; on a fresh clone,
also enable the repository's Git hooks:

```sh
git config core.hooksPath .githooks
just setup
```

Checks use Python 3.11+, uv, Git and just. The corpus, profiles and skills are plain
files and read on their own. Live delivery, the `SessionStart` hook (`hooks/claude-profile`),
and the repository gates (`just check` and `bin/assemble-instructions check`) require
[tasks](https://github.com/khughitt/tasks) (with `lore` and `ops` registered in the
host registry), [ops](https://github.com/khughitt/ops) (for `ops-profile` and the
generated Projects fragment), and [harness-quarters](https://github.com/khughitt/harness-quarters)
(which links lore's outputs and hook into each harness home). Run `just check` and
`just test-full` to verify the corpus and its assembly outputs; routine `just test`
runs on GitHub Actions at push (see [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), Gates).

## Usage

The delivered outputs are the files hq's home links serve. Edit policy in
`instructions/fragments/` and ordering/provenance in `instructions/assembly.toml`.
Run `just assemble` to generate `instructions/AGENTS.md` and
`instructions/AGENTS.manifest.json`. Do not hand-edit either output. Provenance
stays out of the delivered text.

```sh
just assemble                                   # writes instructions/AGENTS.md and instructions/AGENTS.manifest.json
python3 bin/assemble-instructions check         # verifies catalog, sources, manifest, artifact, and live ops renderer
python3 bin/assemble-instructions provenance    # reports all rule claims and coverage warnings
python3 bin/skill-sizes.py                      # prints the skill token/byte inventory
```

To preview an activation without writing the delivered pair, run
`bin/assemble-instructions render` for the artifact and `render --manifest` for its
manifest, adding `--owner-root ops=<prepared ops worktree>` when the Projects input is
not yet merged. The manifest's artifact hash ties the two outputs together.

Ops owns instructions/fragments/projects.md in its checkout. Refresh that source
with just projects in ops, then assemble here. The assembler's read-only check
validates the catalog, sources, manifest, artifact and live Projects renderer;
relevant staged files select the whole prospective index. The session-start notice
still detects a forgotten assembly step after an ops refresh.

Evidence pointers name an owner and a full commit: a project prefix reads that project's
checkout, and `lore:records` reads lore's records directory, which lives in a separate
records repository rather than in this one ([instruction formats](docs/instruction-formats.md)).

`profiles/` and `skills/` remain separately delivered sources. The historical
`verify-baseline` and `verify-initial` proofs run during acceptance and audits, outside
the normal checks ([instruction assembly](docs/instruction-assembly.md)).

## Configuration

- **Harness home links ([harness-quarters](https://github.com/khughitt/harness-quarters)):**
  hq's links.toml links `instructions/AGENTS.md` into each harness home, serves
  `skills/curate-docs`, `skills/references/retained-item-records.md`, and the selected
  skills from `vendor/superpowers` and `vendor/agent-skills` under `~/.agents/skills/`
  and `~/.claude/skills/`, and wires `hooks/claude-profile` into Claude Code and Codex
  `SessionStart` hooks.
- **Profile selection ([ops](https://github.com/khughitt/ops)):** `hooks/claude-profile`
  reads `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tasks/projects.toml` (or `~/.config/tasks/projects.toml`) to
  locate `ops`, then invokes `ops-profile session` to resolve a checkout's profile
  fragment (`profiles/personal.md`, `profiles/work.md`, or `profiles/external.md`) from
  ops's profiles.toml and identity-mirror.toml ([profile delivery](docs/profile-delivery.md)).
- **Assembly catalog (`instructions/assembly.toml`):** declares the ordered fragments
  and owner checkouts (`lore` and `ops`) that `bin/assemble-instructions` composes into
  `instructions/AGENTS.md` and `instructions/AGENTS.manifest.json`
  ([instruction formats](docs/instruction-formats.md)).

## Layout

- `instructions/`: policy fragments, ordered catalog, generated global artifact and manifest.
- Root `AGENTS.md`: the project guide; `bin/assemble-instructions`: assembler and guard.
- `profiles/`, `skills/`, `vendor/superpowers/`, `vendor/agent-skills/`: the instruction corpus.
- `bin/skill-sizes.py`: the skill inventory utility.
- `hooks/claude-profile`: the `SessionStart` hook that puts a checkout's profile text in
  front of every Claude Code and Codex session ([profile delivery](docs/profile-delivery.md)).
- `docs/`: the three reference documents. Working documents (specs, plans, briefs) and
  task records live in the records root (`tasks where` names it). The archived documents'
  history is in the records repository's lore directory; [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) says where
  to look up a commit id from before the 2026-10-27 or 2026-11-05 history rewrite.
- `tools/`: assembly tests/fixtures, pinned proof driver, and shared tooling
  (`tools/tt`, `tools/ops-check`, `tools/ops-docs`, `tools/family.toml`) vendored from
  [ops](https://github.com/khughitt/ops) (see [tools/README.md](tools/README.md)).

- [Instruction formats](docs/instruction-formats.md): data model for the assembly catalog (`instructions/assembly.toml`, version 1), rule provenance sidecars, and the provenance manifest (`instructions/AGENTS.manifest.json`, version 2).
- [Instruction assembly](docs/instruction-assembly.md): operations guide for building, refreshing, checking and auditing the delivered global instructions.
- [Profile delivery](docs/profile-delivery.md): protocol for how `hooks/claude-profile` resolves and prints a checkout's profile fragment at session start.
- [Retained item records](skills/references/retained-item-records.md): guide and data model (retention version 1) for worktree, scratch and off-tree evidence accounting at park and closeout.
- [Skill guide](skills/README.md): layout and ownership of the skill corpus across lore, sibling guild checkouts, and the pinned submodules.
- [Vendored tools](tools/README.md): ownership and update rules for files in `tools/` vendored from [ops](https://github.com/khughitt/ops).
